title: Foliar Symptomology, Nutrient Content, Yield, and Secondary Metabolite Variability of Cannabis Grown Hydroponically with Different Single-Element Nutrient Deficiencies
notes: Cannabis-specific controlled-environment deficiency study. Supports integrated nutrient diagnosis: visual symptom onset did not always align simply with foliar elemental analysis, so symptom pattern, tissue analysis, fertigation/root-zone context and production history should be interpreted together. The study deliberately induced single-element deficiencies and should not be treated as a universal commercial recipe.
